narr: A cold front associated with a low pressure system crossed through eastern Kentucky on the evening of June 13th. Damaging wind gusts occurred in several severe thunderstorms that day, which resulted in a few instances of downed trees across Greenup County. Heavy downpours associated with these storms also resulted in a washed out road in Greenup County.
ev: South of the town of Load, White Oak Road was washed out due to flooding.
lsr: FLOODING HAS WASHED OUT WHITE OAK ROAD
